name: ai-starter-langgraph
description: App de IA completo: chat em Next.js, agente em Python com LangGraph, RAG, memória e aprovação humana no PostgreSQL com pgvector.
//: Cada app em apps/ e autossuficiente: o web com o proprio package-lock, o agente com o proprio uv.lock. A raiz so orquestra.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix apps/web && npm run setup:agent
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n agent,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.dev:agent: cd apps/agent && AGENT_DEV=1 uv run uvicorn agent.main:app --app-dir src --reload --port 8000
scripts.studio: cd apps/agent && uv run langgraph dev
scripts.db: docker run -d --name ai-starter-langgraph-db -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=app -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=app -e POSTGRES_DB=app pgvector/pgvector:pg18
